annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: You will be assigned a personalised EIR, ranging from 18.9% to 29.9% p.a., or such other rate that we determine from time to time
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: (a) The greater of either S$50 or 1% of principal, plus (b) interest, finance fees and charges, and (c) any overlimit amount and past due amount.
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Interest Free Period: Make a full repayment by your payment date or within 15 days after your credit card statement is generated

documents-required.Latest Original Computerised Payslip: Yes + copy of Passport (For Foreigners only)

our_takes.our-take: The Trust Freedom Credit Card works like three cards in one — stockback, cashback or miles — and you can switch modes each quarter without a new application. Stockback is the headline: every eligible dollar builds up stockback value, and once it hits S$10 Trust buys fractional shares of a US stock or ETF you've picked from a list of 50. The S$0 annual fee and S$0 foreign transaction fee apply across all modes, which makes overseas spending straightforward whichever reward you're chasing. Worth considering if you value the flexibility to change your mind each quarter, and are comfortable committing to one reward type at a time.
our_takes.good-for:
All purpose cash back, air miles or stockback credit card, with 1.3 miles for local & overseas OR 1.5% cash back. 3% Stock back as an additional option.
Frequent overseas spenders, since there's no foreign transaction fee and miles are earned at the same 1.3 mpd rate abroad as locally.
First-time investors who'd rather have their spending auto-invested into US stocks or ETFs than open a brokerage account themselves.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Stockback is capped at S$500 a quarter, and the promotional 3% rate drops to 2% local / 0.5% foreign from 1 Jan 2027.
The headline 15% cashback applies to one preferred category only, and needs S$2,000 monthly spend in all three months of the quarter.
Welcome offers are for new-to-trust which are defined as anyone who has not held a principle Trust card at any point in the past.
